description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions related to command-line interface options, such as collecting options, parsing positive integers, and resolving command arguments.

methods.name: collectOption
methods.description: Collects and appends a value to an array of options.

methods.name: parsePositiveIntOrUndefined
methods.description: Parses a value to return a positive integer or undefined for invalid inputs.

methods.name: resolveActionArgs
methods.description: Resolves the arguments from a command object, returning an array of arguments or an empty array.
